Chapter 1088: 21: Lin Yuan'S Foundation (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1088: Chapter 21: Lin Yuan’s Foundation (Seeking Subscription)

In the crimson world filled with endless Fierce Suns, Lin Yuan’s incarnation, condensed from a thread of his spirit, cautiously observed the surroundings.

At the highest point of the crimson world, a figure stood.

This figure possessed millions of forms.

Every time Lin Yuan observed it, he experienced different realizations and insights.

In this crimson world, Lin Yuan once entered when he condensed the thirty thousandth Seed of the Fierce Sun.

He had been here before.

The figure at the highest point is most likely the Ancestor of Fierce Sun from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, a thirteenth-order time life.

Originally, Lin Yuan thought that being able to enter this crimson world was completely by chance, a rare occurrence.

However, upon condensing thirty-three thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun, Lin Yuan suddenly discovered that he had vaguely established a certain connection with this crimson world.

Through this connection, he could enter again.

Realizing this, Lin Yuan began to visit regularly.

He couldn’t help it; this crimson world seemed to be purely a World of Fire.

Yet upon enlightenment, he discovered that the ‘fire’ of this world surprisingly contained thousands upon thousands of cosmic rules, and among them, Lin Yuan found all the rules he had understood.

In addition, the figure at the highest point, suspected to be the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, gave Lin Yuan immense shock.

In the Chaos Void, even unparalleled Great Saints are painstakingly seeking the path of thirteenth-order life, trying to forge ahead to thirteenth-order themselves, hoping to gain a minute possibility.

But in this source world? He could look so closely at a thirteenth-order time life?

If it were those unparalleled Great Saints in the Chaos Void, they would likely go mad with envy. Xuanhuang, the Magic Jade Tower Master, and other unparalleled Great Saints would dream of having Lin Yuan’s opportunity.

“I can enter this world because I have condensed enough Seeds of the Fierce Sun.”

Lin Yuan understood well why he could appear here; it was because of the thin bloodline of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun flowing within him, complemented by the Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

“It’s a pity, that now I need just one more Seed to reach thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-three…”

Lin Yuan looked somewhat helpless.

Thirty-five years ago, Lin Yuan had already condensed thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-two Seeds of the Fierce Sun and had been trying to condense the last one ever since.

As he neared completion, Lin Yuan became increasingly aware that thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-three Seeds represented an entirely different domain.

When the time comes, all the Seeds of the Fierce Sun will form a complete cycle within his body.

Once this grand cycle forms, it will be a great transformation for him.

“Take it slow.”

“A thousand years have merely passed.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts; the complexity and obscurity of the last Seed of the Fierce Sun required even him to carefully comprehend before even attempting to condense it.

Though difficult, with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it should only be a matter of time.

If a thousand years aren’t enough, then two thousand years, three thousand years, five thousand years.

“I can’t continue observing.”

Lin Yuan stayed in the crimson world for a while and began to feel he couldn’t hold on.

This world was filled with omnipresent Fierce Sun fires, and Lin Yuan’s spirit could descend with the protection of the Seeds of the Fierce Sun, but this protection had a time limit.

Whoosh.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan’s spirit-created incarnation dissipated.

In the Sky Burning Court.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“A thousand years of secluded cultivation feels like just the blink of an eye to me…”

Lin Yuan thought, the higher one’s level of life, the more blurred the concept of time becomes. To the Great Lords and Heavenly Venerates, it’s completely normal for millions or billions of years to pass in isolation.

A thousand years? Not even enough for a nap.

“But in these thousand years, my improvements have been considerable…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, the greatest achievement being the Chaos Rule reaching the Second Realm.

From Chaos First Realm to Second Realm, it seemed like merely ascending one level, yet it was the result of Lin Yuan comprehending countless cosmic rules, where quantitative change leads to qualitative transformation.

Improvement in Chaos Rule cannot be directly sensed; it requires the constant understanding and penetration of more and broader cosmic rules.

Typically, Chaos Venerables start with understanding Chaos Rule First Realm, and to reach the Second Realm, one needs to spend ten Cosmic Eras, dozens of Cosmic Eras gradually comprehending countless rules.

Yet Lin Yuan accomplished this in merely a millennium.

And still considered that Lin Yuan’s life level is only at the Path-Splitting Realm, whereas those venerables possess life levels of the Chaos Realm.

The higher the life level, the easier and simpler it is to comprehend cosmic rules.

Standing high, one sees far.

“However, although the understanding of Chaos Rule has reached the Second Realm, using Chaos Rule as a foundation to evolve the Taiji Yin-Yang Power is still without clues.”

Lin Yuan pondered.

In his initial estimation, to evolve Chaos Yin Yang Taiji, Chaos Rule must at least reach the Second Realm.

But the Chaos Rule of the Second Realm is merely one of the prerequisite conditions for evolving Chaos Yin Yang Taiji, not all conditions.

“Chaos births Yin Yang, Chaos births Taiji… how exactly does it birth? How does it evolve?”

Lin Yuan contemplated, “This is a path that is uniquely mine; the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji has no precedence in either the Chaos Void or this source world.”

Even if it seems like a similar path, fundamentally, it’s different.

For instance, the Chaos Flame path that Lord Qingfen follows is completely different from other Great Lords’ Chaos Flame paths; Lord Qingfen’s Chaos Flame is azure, it’s incinerating.

Even similar Chaos Flame paths will present significant differences.

Chaos Yin Yang Taiji is even more so.

“If I couldn’t enter that crimson world and observe the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, a thirteenth-order time life, I fear evolving Chaos Yin Yang Taiji might take ten thousand, a million years, and still might not be achievable.”
